title: Hypervisor & VM Overview
description: Ops overview of KVM hypervisors and their VMs (PCP + pmdalibvirt, historical via PCP Redis/Valkey).

panels.title: Hypervisors
panels.description: Latest values for every hypervisor reporting into the collector. Click a host name to focus the dashboard on it.

panels.title: Cockpit
panels.description: Hypervisor PCP agents as seen from the collector. Click a tile to open that hypervisor's Cockpit for troubleshooting.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Non-idle time across all host CPUs.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Physical memory in use, excluding reclaimable cache.

panels.title: vCPUs allocated
panels.description: Sum of vCPUs across running VMs.

panels.title: VM memory allocated
panels.description: Sum of memory assigned to running VMs.

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: User time includes time spent running guest vCPUs.

panels.title: Host network (physical)
panels.description: Physical NICs and bonds (VLAN sub-interfaces, bridges and vnets hidden). Transmit is drawn below zero. SR-IOV VF traffic bypasses the host stack and is NOT included.

panels.title: Virtual machines on $host (live)
panels.description: Running VMs on this host, live from its pmproxy. CPU % is relative to the VM's own vCPUs; Memory % is the qemu process RSS on the host relative to the VM's assigned memory. Network covers virtio/tap interfaces only (SR-IOV VFs are not visible to libvirt).

panels.title: VM CPU
panels.description: Percent of each VM's allocated vCPUs.

panels.title: VM network throughput
panels.description: Transmit is drawn below zero. virtio/tap interfaces only.
